challenges.name: Yawning Chasm
challenges.description: A deep ravine cuts the path. The far side is just within leap distance — but only just.
challenges.successText: You leap clean across, landing in a roll!
challenges.failText: You slip on the edge — barely catch the lip and haul yourself up, scraped raw.

challenges.name: Sleeping Ogre
challenges.description: An ogre snores across the path, club in hand. One wrong step and it wakes.
challenges.successText: You tiptoe past in dead silence — the ogre never stirs.
challenges.failText: A twig snaps. The ogre swings half-awake, catching you a glancing blow.

challenges.name: Ancient Rune Gate
challenges.description: Glowing runes seal the forest's edge. Decipher them or take the gate's wrath.
challenges.successText: The runes ripple and the gate dissolves — way is clear!
challenges.failText: Mistranslation! Arcane backlash sears your mind.
